# Get Music Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given song.

## Syntax

~~~~text
musicDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, music: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
musicDetail(detail: Title, music: Favorite Song)
~~~~
